title: Local Network Permission Prompt Not Shown After Android 17 OS Upgrade and Reboot

blocks.text: With Android 17, apps are now required to explicitly request permission before accessing your local network. When a device running Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0 for Android upgrades to Android 17 and reboots, the Android OS might start the Zscaler VPN service in the background before the user has granted the Local Network permission. The Android OS does not display interactive permission prompts for background services. As a result, users might not see the permission prompt until they open the Zscaler Client Connector app, and network connectivity might be affected in the meantime.
End users and administrators can use the following workarounds until this issue is resolved:

blocks.item: End Users: After upgrading to Android 17 and rebooting, open Zscaler Client Connector from the device home screen or launcher. When prompted, tap Allow for the Local Network permission.

Administrators: To help provide an uninterrupted experience across OS upgrades and reboots, configure the MDM/EMM policy to auto-grant ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK for Zscaler Client Connector. The permission appears under Nearby devices / Local network.
